name: Edit and Manage Product for WooCommerce
author: sjrubel10

sections.description:
Tired of spending hours editing WooCommerce products one by one? The WooCommerce Bulk & Single Product Editor is here to revolutionize how you manage your online store. Whether you need to update prices, adjust stock levels, modify categories, or edit custom attributes, this powerful plugin makes it easy to handle everything in bulk or individually—all within a few clicks.

Designed for store owners, managers, and developers, this plugin simplifies product management, saving you time and reducing errors. With its intuitive interface and advanced features, you can efficiently manage thousands of products without breaking a sweat. Perfect for small shops or large e-commerce marketplaces, this plugin is your ultimate solution for seamless WooCommerce product editing.

Key Features

  • Bulk Edit WooCommerce Attributes Easily update product attributes such as prices, stock levels, categories, tags, and more for multiple products at once. Save time by making mass changes with just a few clicks.

  • Individual Product Editing Gain full control over individual products. Edit attributes like stock, price, custom fields, or tags with precision for unique product configurations.

  • ** Variable Product Editing** Variable products in WooCommerce are a type of product that allows customers to choose from various options, such as size, color, or material. Each variation has its own price, stock level, SKU, and other attributes, making managing these products crucial for store owners. Editing variable products can be done in two ways: single editing and bulk editing. Here’s an overview

  • Custom Field Management Effortlessly manage and edit custom fields and attributes, ensuring all product metadata is up-to-date and accurate for better organization and usability.

  • SEO Attribute Management Optimize your WooCommerce store for search engines by bulk editing SEO-related fields, including product titles, descriptions, and tags. Improve organic traffic by keeping your metadata consistent and optimized.

  • Product Feed Generation for Multiple Platforms Create product feeds compatible with major platforms such as Google Merchant Center, Facebook, Instagram, and others. Export accurate and up-to-date product data to meet the specific requirements of various merchants.

  • Plugin Compatibility Works seamlessly with other WooCommerce plugins, enhancing its functionality without conflicts. It integrates smoothly with plugins for SEO, analytics, or feed generation to complement your store’s ecosystem.

  • Undo/Redo Options Instantly reverse or redo changes to avoid mistakes. This functionality ensures you can work confidently while making edits, even on large datasets.

  • Advanced Filters Narrow down your product list for edits using filters like category, tag, attribute, or custom criteria. Perform targeted updates without manually searching for products.

  • Schedule Changes Plan updates for product prices, stock levels, or other attributes in advance. Automate your workflow and stay ahead of seasonal sales or promotions.

  • Performance OptimizedDesigned for large WooCommerce stores, the plugin handles thousands of products efficiently without slowing down your website, ensuring a smooth user experience.

Why Choose This Plugin?

Managing a WooCommerce store doesn’t have to be a headache. Here’s why the WooCommerce Bulk & Single Product Editor is a game-changer:

Save Time: Edit hundreds or thousands of products in minutes, not hours.

Reduce Errors: Bulk editing minimizes manual mistakes and ensures consistency.

Boost Productivity: Spend less time on admin tasks and more time growing your business.

Scalable Performance: Optimized for high performance, even with large product catalogs.

SEO Optimization: Easily update SEO-related attributes to drive more organic traffic.

Who Is This Plugin For?

This plugin is perfect for:

E-commerce Store Owners: Streamline product management for any niche—fashion, electronics, groceries, and more.

WooCommerce Managers: Simplify your workflow and save time managing large product inventories.

Developers & Designers: Effortlessly handle product updates while building and maintaining WooCommerce stores.

How It Works

Select Products: Use advanced filters to choose products by category, tag, attribute, or custom criteria.

Edit Attributes: Update prices, stock, categories, tags, or custom fields in bulk or individually.

Preview Changes: Use the real-time preview feature to ensure accuracy before applying edits.

Apply & Track: Save your changes and track every modification with detailed change logs.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. For more details, visit GNU General Public License.
sections.installation:
Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/woocommerce-bulk-single-product-editor/ directory, or install the plugin directly through the WordPress plugins screen.

Activate the plugin via the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

Navigate to WooCommerce > Product Editor to start managing your products.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin work with all WooCommerce product types?

Yes! It supports simple, variable, grouped, and external products.

Can I undo changes if I make a mistake?

Absolutely. The plugin includes undo/redo functionality to reverse any unwanted edits.

Does it support custom attributes?

Yes, you can bulk edit custom attributes and fields with ease.

Is this plugin compatible with my theme and other plugins?

The plugin follows WooCommerce coding standards, ensuring compatibility with most themes and plugins.

Can I track changes made to products?

Yes, the plugin provides detailed change logs to track every edit, including who made the change and when.
